newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Death toll from HK tower block fire rises to nine.
newsitem.headline: Death toll from HK tower block fire rises to nine.

text.p: The death toll from a fire that raged through a Hong Kong residential building on Tuesday has risen to nine, the government said on Thursday.
A 53-year-old woman died early on Thursday from injuries in a fire which had already claimed eight lives, a spokewoman said.
On Tuesday residents squatted on window ledges and clung to drainpipes to escape the fire as it spread from a sixth-floor apartment in a 20-storey block in Kowloon's Mei Foo district.
The dead included two babies. Investigations are continuing into the cause of the fire.
Hong Kong has suffered some of its worst building fires on record in recent months.
In November, a fire in a building in Kowloon's Nathan Road tourist shopping street killed 39 people and injured 81.
A fire in a karaoke bar in January killed 17 people in Kowloon's Tsim Sha Tsui entertainment district.
